title: Meter
description: The HUD meter's state for one run (PRD 14.4, FR-MTR-07): credits used (the sum of the run's event credits), credits saved (origin cost minus lookup cost over accepted reuses, PRD 14.3), time saved (estimate) and the run's budget. packages/metering computes it from the run's events up to last_seq, and apps/web renders it. Rules MT-05 and MT-06 in contracts/metering.rules.md.

last_seq.description: seq of the last event this state includes. A client shows a state only if its last_seq is higher than the one on screen (MT-06).

time_saved.description: Time saved in minutes (PRD 14.2, FR-MTR-05): finished, verified units times the EV-G2 median minutes per unit, minus measured steering and review minutes. low and high use the EV-G2 25th and 75th percentiles. It can be negative when steering took longer than the baseline and is shown as it is, never clamped. steering_measured is false when the run has no measured attention spans; the meter then says that steering time was not measured instead of subtracting zero. method_url links to the method page; the meter always shows it as an estimate with its range.

method_url.description: An https URL of host, optional port and path, with no user info, query or fragment. The not-pattern rejects a final line break, which a Python validator's $ lets through.

budget.description: The run's Treasury state (PRD 14.1): the approved cap, credits committed and credits reserved by running steps. spent plus reserved never exceeds cap unless an overrun (an actual cost above its reservation, recorded in full) has halted the run (MT-03, MT-05).
